gaps.title: Material Cataloging Persistence
gaps.jtbd: When saving an epidemiological material, I want the system to persist its cataloging metadata, so that materials can be effectively cataloged as requested.
gaps.acceptanceCriteria: Given a material with category and tags, When the material is submitted, Then the backend successfully persists these fields in the database.
gaps.reason: COVERAGE: The brief explicitly requires 'каталогизации' (cataloging) of materials, but the backend MaterialEntity and Service completely omit and fail to persist taxonomy fields like category and tags.

gaps.title: Material Management Access Control
gaps.jtbd: When managing the knowledge base, I want to restrict material uploads and modifications to authenticated users, so that unauthorized actors cannot corrupt or delete epidemiological records.
gaps.acceptanceCriteria: Given an unauthenticated request, When attempting to POST, PUT, or DELETE to /api/materials, Then the server responds with 401 Unauthorized.
gaps.reason: DOMAIN-STANDARD: A knowledge base management system requires access control for write operations to maintain data integrity, but the /api/materials endpoints are currently completely public.
